claims.title: Direct floor-correct Type-II numerical slack
claims.statement: Under actual Hyps and C>=100, B>=a/Q² gives floor(B/(Yk²))>=B/(2Yk²) and 3r p^(-L1-1)B<=sl/8. B>=a/Q gives sl>=100r²cP. This supplies hII5 and hII0 without retaining the general parameter lemmas.
assumptions: Literal actual Type-II setting, orbit and weight hypotheses; the threshold and auxiliary choices specified in the report.

claims.title: Actual Hyp26 and MFH from frame geometry
claims.statement: The stronger L2 gaps and full segment span give dLL<=3a p^(-D-L1-1), Bo>=a/p^(D+g)>=a/Q, including the periodic wrap. CP1 yields r dLL/P+26r cP<=3sl/8 and sl>=128cP. Hence literal Hyp26 and every MFH clause hold.
assumptions: Literal actual Type-II setting, orbit and weight hypotheses; the threshold and auxiliary choices specified in the report.

claims.title: Actual chain and projector size budgets 20 and 9
claims.statement: Actual one-period late letters number<=N, chains<=N, counted links<=N, normal cuts<=2N. Degree bounds and Legendre imply Dm+Dl+3kp<=20L, kappa_fl<=20L and SizeAt9. In particular cP>80L>4MD; no additional local numerical budget is assumed.
assumptions: Literal actual Type-II setting, orbit and weight hypotheses; the threshold and auxiliary choices specified in the report.

claims.title: Constructing the literal selected signed-chain object
claims.statement: The unit coefficient, exact digit class, plane/normal degrees, actual signs and carries, finite prefix chains, T_u-sl/8 thresholds and positive T_u-3sl/8 link thresholds construct mkDt. Select the joint projector first at zero normal weights, then update thresholds without changing its operators. DT/IW provide digit units and coefficient selection; IN/WT supply actual incoming membership.
assumptions: Literal actual Type-II setting, orbit and weight hypotheses; the threshold and auxiliary choices specified in the report.

claims.title: Actual constrained test with normalized exponent 50L
claims.statement: On the constructed data PG26,2,24,60, DT selection cost9L, MD<=20L and kappa_fl<=20L give normalized integral value dividing p^ceil(49L), with ceil(49L)<=50L. Actual MFH makes DT outgoing membership applicable. This supplies Proposition5At and NSStep without extra local budget assumptions.
assumptions: Literal actual Type-II setting, orbit and weight hypotheses; the threshold and auxiliary choices specified in the report.

claims.title: Uniform normal-degree height with constant 10
claims.statement: RK and EA bound the actual source normal degree by X. The fixed multiplier has normal degree zero; conjugated elementary operators raise it by<=1, with at most Nc0 operators. All one-sided tests of order above floor(X)+Nc0 pair to zero and may be discarded, proving Ct0=10 uniformly in the primitive input.
assumptions: Literal actual Type-II setting, orbit and weight hypotheses; the threshold and auxiliary choices specified in the report.

claims.title: Actual realization-to-dual map and integral pairing error
claims.statement: For the actual OR-realizable one-sided symbols, normalized opposite-edge Fock duality gives T with target height tF, own-edge integrality, other-edge order cP and beta_fl=y+w^cP z. Since cP>2DX, the new value still divides p^DX. This proves actual FlatAt; OR is separately proved, not inferred from regular source-symbol realization.
assumptions: Literal actual Type-II setting, orbit and weight hypotheses; the threshold and auxiliary choices specified in the report.

claims.title: Uniform primitive cloud with constants 10 and 54
claims.statement: CB/CL primitive-array detection, IW/CL contraction cost4L and CP7 flat cost50L yield actual cloud witnesses Ct0=10,CD1=54, other-edge order c* and the literal height bound. The integral scalar in the contraction need not be a unit: x(cb)=p^(kappa+DX). Thresholds are chosen before all local data. OR proves its actual threshold100, so CloudStep(C,10,54,1088) holds for every C>=4129 under the literal Type-II hypotheses.
assumptions: Literal actual Type-II setting, orbit and weight hypotheses; the threshold and auxiliary choices specified in the report.
